summary: The served Qwen3.8-27B merge with MTP k=3 speculative decoding was re-measured under vLLM 0.29.0 with the same container arguments, prompt and harness as its August reference under 0.26.0, in tensor parallel 2 on one pair. Single-stream throughput rose, eight-request throughput stayed stable, time to first token improved and the draft acceptance rate did not fall, so the setting was kept. Speed only; output quality was not re-judged.
title: Re-measuring MTP k=3 speculative decoding after a vLLM upgrade
